scope: Visible sampled performance effects and MIDI-mode interpretation in the reused original PSS780 tour; source-specific benchmark policy evidence, not hardware MIDI trace or synthesis law.

protocol.scope: Three sampled visible LED states per preset in one reused video, not continuous state or effect-algorithm recovery

protocol.classification: ON above threshold+10, OFF below threshold-10, otherwise UNKNOWN. No per-LED threshold or later adjustment.
protocol.consensus: All three samples must be the same known state; any disagreement or unknown is unresolved, with every sample retained.
protocol.comparison: Only after classification compare Vibrato/Sustain with raw byte24 bits7/6. Other four states have no field in the imported voice data.
limits: Video/patches have already been used throughout development; not a fresh recording or unseen holdout.
The two calibration frames contribute to the300 samples and are not independent validation.
ObservedLCD timing selects snapshots only; no sample-accurate delivered program or MIDI timestamp is inferred.
Fixed pixels can fail under camera motion, scan flicker, obstruction or codec artifacts; unresolved cases are not filled from factory flags.
Visible LED state does not identify audio routing, external processing, actual parameter values or effect implementation.

limits: Selected after primary LED audit and prior pitch/tail analyses; not unseen data.
